verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers no-code workflow building, report types (Document, Facial Similarity, Watchlist, Known Faces), webhooks and Dashboard document filtering. Nothing describes a manual review queue for borderline cases, a reviewer view of document images, extracted fields and check results, or reviewer decisions being written back to the verification record. Workflow Studio and Dashboard configuration are adjacent features, not this capability.

support.subject: As an ops lead, borderline verifications land in a manual review queue with the full evidence — document images, extracted fields, check results — and reviewer decisions feed back into the record
